title: Dremel: Interactive Analysis of Web-Scale Datasets
authors: Sergey Melnik, Andrey Gubarev, Jing Jing Long, Geoffrey Romer, Shiva Shivakumar, Matt Tolton, Theo Vassilakis
description: Presents Dremel, Google's scalable interactive query system for read-only nested data, combining a novel columnar storage format with repetition and definition levels with a multi-level serving tree to execute aggregation queries over trillion-row tables in seconds.
